/deepducking [toggle main window]

/deepducking mini [toggle Mini]
/deepducking settings [open Settings]

/deepducking resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/deepducking nextstop [exit after next boss]
/deepducking ns [exit after next boss]
/deepducking stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/deepducking reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]

/deepducking inspect [record read-only client and native observations]

/deepducking saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]

3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which

3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"Gluttony Combo","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.4.340","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v1.0.4.340 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt in the same custom window style as the other plugins and polished for the real in-game font and scale, with every preset, option and saved setting unchanged.
- The window uses a two-level layout: Combos, Automation and System tabs, a row of destinations for the open tab, a page header and a status footer that stays in view. Long pages fade out above the footer instead of being cut off.
- Preset cards have even padding, a larger title and toggles that sit inside the card, and a whole toggle row, label included, can be clicked. Search keeps one width on every page, shows a dimmed hint, has a clear button and reports a result count.
- The problem report button sits in the footer so it is reachable on every page and window size, and the status pill shows a running rotation in green and a blocked one in amber.
- This build also picks up the restyled shared What's new window and Report a problem popup.

v1.0.4.339 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.335 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **AoE heals no longer fire back to back on a party that is at or near full HP.** Follow-up to 1.0.4.334: on a party whose bars all read full or nearly full, the auto-rotation kept pressing AoE heals - a bar just under 100% never counted as full (regen-tick oscillation and display rounding), and a heal that had just gone out did not stand the press path down while it landed. Two changes, shared by Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage. First, a member only counts as needing an AoE heal on a real deficit: a bar at or above 98% reads as full for both the one-button average and the auto-rotation's member count, so no threshold setting (including the 100 "disable this check" setting, and a target count of 0, which is now floored at 1) can make a full party eligible. Second, the auto-rotation presses one AoE heal at a time: after a press goes out, the next waits out that cast's flight plus a second for the heal to land and party HP to propagate, so a movement-cancelled cast is no longer re-issued every tick. {"Author":"dajoey","Name":"Gluttony Combo","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.4.340","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v1.0.4.340 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt in the same custom window style as the other plugins and polished for the real in-game font and scale, with every preset, option and saved setting unchanged.
- The window uses a two-level layout: Combos, Automation and System tabs, a row of destinations for the open tab, a page header and a status footer that stays in view. Long pages fade out above the footer instead of being cut off.
- Preset cards have even padding, a larger title and toggles that sit inside the card, and a whole toggle row, label included, can be clicked. Search keeps one width on every page, shows a dimmed hint, has a clear button and reports a result count.
- The problem report button sits in the footer so it is reachable on every page and window size, and the status pill shows a running rotation in green and a blocked one in amber.

v1.0.4.339 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.335 (2026-11-07) [testing]
- **AoE heals no longer fire back to back on a party that is at or near full HP.** Follow-up to 1.0.4.334: on a party whose bars all read full or nearly full, the auto-rotation kept pressing AoE heals - a bar just under 100% never counted as full (regen-tick oscillation and display rounding), and a heal that had just gone out did not stand the press path down while it landed. Two changes, shared by Astrologian, White Mage, Scholar and Sage. First, a member only counts as needing an AoE heal on a real deficit: a bar at or above 98% reads as full for both the one-button average and the auto-rotation's member count, so no threshold setting (including the 100 "disable this check" setting, and a target count of 0, which is now floored at 1) can make a full party eligible. Second, the auto-rotation presses one AoE heal at a time: after a press goes out, the next waits out that cast's flight plus a second for the heal to land and party HP to propagate, so a movement-cancelled cast is no longer re-issued every tick. Real damage is never starved - a party still under the threshold after the window heals again immediately. {"Author":"Valenth Siveria","Name":"I Am Ready","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.1.0.0","Changelog":"API15 finally","DalamudApiLevel":"15","Description":"# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

- **Market-price lookups no longer log warnings while they retry.** When Universalis is slow or busy it answers with a temporary "try again" status or takes longer than before; the price client already retries those on its own with a pause between tries - that is its designed behavior, not a fault, so those lines now go to the debug log. - **The price client now waits up to 60 seconds per request instead of 20.** Under load, Universalis sometimes finishes a large price query just after the old 20-second cutoff; the request was cancelled while the server was still working on it and the prices for that batch were refetched from scratch. - Market-price log lines no longer paste a hundred item numbers into the log; a batch is described as its item count instead.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- Full harness: 401/401 PASS (6 new).

- **Knightshopper no longer buys units that are sitting on a retainer.** The purchase target counted everything the catalog can see, but the fetch-from-retainer step runs after the purchase and brings those units in anyway - with 90 units on a retainer, none in the bags and 9 missing, the run bought 99 instead of 9. - Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

{"Author":"Akari","Name":"Mahjong Advisor","AcceptsFeedback":true,"ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.4.4.0","CanUnloadAsync":false,"CategoryTags":["Utility"],"Changelog":"v0.4.4.0: Chi picker freeze fix. When a call prompt's claimed tile could not be identified, the single-shape chi gate counted shapes for the wrong tile: each candidate offered one run, but the actual tile completed two, so the game opened its shape-selection dialog - which ignores call callbacks - and the match froze (live at South 4 while leading 38,400; bundle 20261030-081345). Chi now fires only when the claim is pinned to one tile, or when every tile that could legally be on offer completes exactly one run; anything else passes instead. The picker-stall warning also logs once rather than every frame. The stale Advisor block that earlier builds wrote into the plugin config is no longer serialised: it was never read, is ignored on load, and disappears at the next config save. An experimental rollout-search re-ranking of discard candidates is included but ships OFF: a 240-match paired simulator A/B (two seeds) rejected it - it traded a 39% relative win-rate drop for nothing - so it stays a foundation for later work. v0.4.3.0: Result-screen retry. The result panel can swallow the first advance callback while it animates; the controller fired it twice and then its acted guard blocked every retry, leaving the screen waiting indefinitely (live Advanced freeze, state 29 unresolved for 12s). Advances now retry every 2.5 seconds while the result state persists, capped at 8 attempts so the deliberately manual match-end screen is not spammed. v0.4.2.0: Match-level tuning. A full hanchan evaluator now plays East+South with real score accounting, dealer rotation, honcha, riichi sticks and placement, and 120 paired matches showed the old risk settings were too passive. Win value 1800 and deal-in cost 4000 beat 1300/5200 on identical deals (average place 2.55 vs 2.65, more firsts, fewer fourths) with the deal-in rate unchanged at 9.3%. A v7 config migration applies the new values. Riichi hand value and placement stance were also tested and left unchanged - both were flat across 60-match arms. v0.4.1.0: Advanced-table defence. Cross-seat genbutsu now uses the pond lengths captured at the instant a riichi marker appears; the old turn-count shortcut broke once calls shortened ponds and could mark a tile discarded before the riichi as safe. Two declared riichi also force a fold for any hand that is not tenpai, overriding the placement chase. The simulator now records the same declaration snapshots: over 1,000 hands the defence fix moved deal-in rate from 10.3% to 9.5% and average points from -22 to +17, while the double-riichi rail was neutral there because the simulation has no placement stance. Live Advanced trial on 0.4.0.0 finished 1st, 4th, then leading when stopped; the 4th lost two deal-ins to one riichi player, the second 12,000 while two were in riichi. v0.4.0.0: Exact scoring core. Completed hands are now scored by yaku, fu, dora and the payment table (closed and open, riichi through yakuman), and the offline simulator uses that scoring for win legality and payouts. Ready-hand valuation was built and benchmarked but stays out of live decisions: over 1,500 simulated hands, mixing exact tenpai values with the existing one-away estimate cut the win rate from 15.4% to 8.1%, so the value scale must be unified for every shanten first. Advice is memoised per table state so the overlay and controller do not recompute the same decision. v0.3.10.0: Silent-endgame defence. The threat model measured a silent opponent as at most 19% likely tenpai, so on a table with no riichi and no melds every safety rule stayed off - the controller pushed one-away hands with 6-9 tiles left to draw into damaten twice in one match (4,200 and 2,200 deal-ins) and paid full tsumo on 14,300 and 20,000 hands. Silent seats now take on a readiness floor that rises from zero at wall 32 to a concrete threat at wall 16, arming the existing late-wall fold and per-tile safety ranking on quiet tables. v0.3.9.0: Chi freeze fixed. The shape-selection dialog ignores scripted call picks (confirmed by the first picker dump), so chi now only fires when exactly one shape is possible - that path completes with no dialog. Multi-shape chi passes instead of stalling; the pass log records how many shapes were declined. v0.3.8.0: Late-wall defence. When an opponent is a concrete threat and the wall is down to the last four go-arounds, the controller folds any hand that is not tenpai instead of pushing a 1-shanten no-riichi hand. This was the 12,000 deal-in in the first match. Diagnostic bundles now also include chi picker dumps. The end-of-match results screen still waits for you by design - that is the one click after a match. v0.3.7.0: Chi is now fully automated. The controller calls chi when the advisor ranks it best, and if the client shows the shape-selection surface it fires the first variant and re-evaluates the hand. The picker layout is dumped once per session to the log folder so shape-specific selection can be refined against real captures. A v6 config migration enables chi. v0.3.6.0: Read each opponent meld strip independently. A hidden empty strip for one quiet seat no longer suppresses every visible meld on the table, so the threat model sees called sets when they exist. This is a readiness/defence accuracy change; automation logic is unchanged. v0.3.5.0: Fix the second freeze. A complete open hand is no longer assumed to be a legal tsumo: the controller checks for an actual yaku and keeps discarding when there is none. Call prompts now prefer the newest board addition over a possibly stale pond tile (the live log claimed 6z/dragon while the actual Pon was 9m), and the log records the last discard tile/seat. A v5 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging. v0.3.4.0: Fix the self-kan freeze. A Kan/Pass bar at state 6 is ignored and the normal discard proceeds instead of firing a Pass callback the client ignores. Session stats are preserved after /mjadv stop so the bundle still shows the run, and a v4 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging for the next launch. v0.3.3.0: Reset the exposed tuning sliders to the fitted win-rate defaults (base hand value 1300, deal-in 5200, noten 1500, opponent hand 4000) with a one-time v3 config migration. Diagnostic bundles now include the actual Dalamud plugin config file from pluginConfigs. v0.3.2.0: State 15 is now treated as the generic other-players state unless real call buttons are present, state 22 (forced riichi discard) is automated, and state 27 (between-hands result/score) is recognised instead of showing stale advice. Overlay/advice are now gated to actual decision states, and diagnostic bundles can read the Dalamud log while it is open. v0.3.1.0: Auto-play and file logging are now on by default, /mjadv session starts a clean logged session, and /mjadv bundle packages the recent JSONL logs, config, layouts, Dalamud log tail and a full last-read snapshot into one zip. Status changes are now logged as auto-status records. v0.3.0.1: Re-arm auto-play on a state change even when the hand happens to repeat, and wait for the Riichi/Pass prompt to close before cutting the riichi tile. v0.3.0.0: Optional auto-play. Replays the client's FireCallback protocol for discards, calls, riichi, ron/tsumo and result advancement, using the reference solver's live-verified handshake and timing guards. Off by default; /mjadv auto [on/off] or /mjadv stop toggles it. Pon/ron/tsumo/riichi are enabled by default, chi and kan are opt-in, the chi shape picker pauses for a manual choice, and the new-hand screen is never auto-advanced. Added /mjadv hand and /mjadv options diagnostics. v0.2.0.2: Keep the previous wall count, so the wall-jump half of new-hand detection actually fires. v0.2.0.1: Reset the pond baselines at the start of a new hand, so the first discard of the hand is tracked and the first call prompt gets the right claimed tile. v0.2.0.0: Meld containers now read by default (112-115 families), with a fail-closed check against our own called-meld count. Own meld tiles are recovered from hand deltas when nodes are unavailable, so ukeire no longer counts tiles already in a call. Riichi detection is marker-node only; the dead rotation and score-drop paths are gone. One node-tree walk per read instead of up to seven. Fixed dead hands getting a nonzero win rate and Pass inventing a yaku path. Red-five decoding accepts both absolute and alias ids. Removed the obsolete fold-threshold setting. Setup window no longer reopens every launch. Added /mjadv melds diagnostics and richer log records.","DalamudApiLevel":15,"Description":"Reads your Doman Mahjong hand, discards, dora, scores and called melds, then ranks each discard by hand speed against deal-in risk. Auto-play and file logging are on by default in this build: sit at a casual table and it plays, then /mjadv bundle packages the logs for support. /mjadv stop or the Automation tab returns to manual suggestions instantly. Discard piles and meld strips are found automatically; the node tools are only a fallback.\nhttps://raw.githubusercontent.com/dexcss/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json","DownloadLinkInstall":"https://github.com/dexcss/MahjongAdvisor/releases/latest/download/MahjongAdvisor.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://github.com/dexcss/MahjongAdvisor/releases/latest/download/MahjongAdvisor.zip","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://github.com/dexcss/MahjongAdvisor/releases/latest/download/MahjongAdvisor.zip","InternalName":"Mahjong.Advisor.Plugin","IsTestingExclusive":false,"LoadPriority":0,"LoadRequiredState":0,"LoadSync":false,"MinimumDalamudVersion":null,"Punchline":"Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.","RepoUrl":"https://github.com/dexcss/MahjongAdvisor","Tags":["mahjong","doman","gold-saucer","auto-play","advisor"],"TestingAssemblyVersion":"0.4.4.0","TestingDalamudApiLevel":15}

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"PvP Solver","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.18","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v0.1.2.18 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The first-start tutorial has a new look and walks through the PvP Solver settings window tab by tab, with buttons that open the matching tab.
- The control and cooldown windows have a clean bordered look, and an unlocked window can be moved by a small handle along its top edge.
- The full legacy settings window has a matching header that shows the plugin version, with a Reset button and a close button. The reset and restore confirmations in the Advanced tab no longer show a plain title bar.
- The What's new window and the Report a problem popup now use the same custom window style as the plugin windows.

v0.1.2.17 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The window uses a header band with a brand chip, a drawn close button, a fixed-width status pill, a section band and a footer with the main action.
- Settings are rows inside cards, with the label and a muted help line on the left, the control on the right and a Reset beside any value that differs from its default.
- Slider values are printed beside the track and still open for typing with Ctrl+click; the target priority list has Up, Down and Remove buttons and an In use now tag, and the job picker shows one row per role.
- Buttons and link chips wrap instead of clipping, dropdowns are as wide as their longest option, and the reset and restore confirmations are centred over the window with a dimmed backdrop.

v0.1.2.16 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt as a responsive card-based shell with custom two-level navigation, toggle tracks, styled sliders and choices, a custom close button in place of the native title bar, and a persistent Stop footer. Rotation, targeting, presets and saved settings are unchanged.

v0.1.2.15 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.2.14 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

- Routine sub-checks. A routine can have its own boxes: one for each roulette, a Tank You pick, 12 allied society boxes and Grand Company chips. "Edit routines" changes the rows.
- Relics by job. The Relics area has a By job view and line cards with progress bars. To fill the Armor and GARO frames, update Tales of Milestones to this version and import a new export.

- Settings area. Character, display, and backup and import settings are in one area. The Ledger holds up to 8 characters, and times can show in UTC or local time.
- Themes. The three themes are Lunar night, Crystarium and Light. Expansion tags use the colours of the Lodestone patch notes.
- Jobs meter. The rail has a Jobs meter that adds your combat, crafting and gathering levels, out of 3,330.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added. - Books count per weapon. The game keeps one book at a time, bound to one weapon, and the Bravura's finished Skyearth I read as the Thyrus' ninth book: the autopilot sent the Thyrus Atma to Jalzahn with no books done. The 9 books now count as done only when G'jusana shows every set complete for the weapon in hand. A finished book, or one of a weapon past the books, is thrown away when she offers it for the next one. An unfinished book of another weapon stops the purchase and says so.
- Relic gearset: your own gearsets are never written any more. With the relic in hand on a gearset that saves another weapon you still have, a new gearset is made for the relic, as the Novus step already did. 0.8.48 and earlier overwrote the WHM gearset with the unfinished Thyrus. A gearset that saves a relic or a weapon that is gone is still updated. During A Relic Reborn, when WigglyQuest puts your own gearset on, the relic gearset goes back on.
- Jalzahn trips: the gearset switch that takes the relic off skips gearsets whose weapon is gone. The WHM gearset still held the unfinished Thyrus after the Zenith trade, the game asked "Replace it with Thyrus Zenith?" and the trip stopped. The relic gearset option now also saves a later stage of the relic over a weapon that is gone.
- Books: new option "Zodiac material quests alongside the books", off by default, for a second weapon on. The book run takes the four material quests and hands them in before each book and each objective, and buys the books in the smart order. 10 of the quests' 16 dungeon drops then come from the books' dungeons. The other 6 dungeons and the HQ hand-ins stay for the Nexus to Zodiac step. It buys only the first hand-ins' items and keeps 100 Poetics for the next book.
- Atma farm: FATEs with 2 minutes or less left are not picked. They ended before the farm arrived and fought.
- Atma farm: FATEs that last more than 15 minutes, like Lazy for You at 30 minutes, are left for others. They are made for many players. A checkbox under the Atma farm turns this off.
- Report a problem: the .log file now starts with a Now section (zone, position, job, WigglyQuest's quest and step, the autopilot's step, the job list and every runner at work) and also keeps WigglyQuest's lines and the warnings of other plugins. A line that repeats within a minute is counted instead of written again.
- A Relic Reborn, step 10 (the quest enemies): the character stood still in Outer La Noscea because the spawn centre is off the navmesh. It now looks up to 60 y around it for a spot it can walk to and waits there.
- Mini window and status: while A Relic Reborn runs, they show the quest step out of 19 and what it asks for (for example step 7 of 19, Amdapor Keep). Before, the mini window showed no progress for a job without a relic, and the status kept an old restart note.
- A Relic Reborn on a second job: the step that examines the destination at the Weeping Saint (Chimera) or the Hall of the Bestiarii (Hydra) is skipped when the destination is gone. It is gone once an earlier relic opened the trial, and WigglyQuest waited on it until it gave up.
- A Relic Reborn: once Gerolt has the weapon (sequence 4 on), the autopilot no longer buys and melds another one. The Main tab lists it as handed in.
- Mini window: the Mahatma bars from 0.8.37 never showed, and the window stopped drawing after the step line while the Mahatmas were farmed. Fixed.
- Mini window: an error while drawing it no longer replaces it with Dalamud's error panel. It goes to the log with the part of the window it came from.
- Main tab: a job list under Job. Add the jobs to do after the picked one and order them with Up and Down. When a job reaches the target stage, the autopilot switches to the next job's gearset and goes on with its relic. Jobs already at the target are skipped.
- Mini window: while the Mahatmas are farmed it shows the weapon's Mahatmas out of 12 and the attached Mahatma's points out of 40.
- Main tab: the Bombard Core row has a Buy button. It goes to your Grand Company quartermaster and exchanges seals for the missing cores you can afford, then stops. The material quests also use it when ADS has no route to him.
- When ADS cannot buy a Bombard Core, ZodiacHelper goes to your Grand Company's quartermaster and exchanges the seals itself. ADS had no route to the Storm Quartermaster in Limsa. It only confirms when the game's prompt names the item.
- The Zodiac material quests check your Grand Company rank before buying a Bombard Core. The quartermaster only sells it from Second Lieutenant (rank 9), so below that the run stops and says so, instead of passing on ADS's "No reachable, unlocked NPC route".
- Mmmmmm, Soulglazed Relics, Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac and The Vital Title are done by ZodiacHelper instead of WigglyQuest. Next to Jalzahn it talks to him straight away, and again 1.5 seconds later when the next step is him too. Gerolt, 45 yalms away, is reached on the mount without flying. If a talk fails, WigglyQuest takes over as before.
- The market board limits (gil cap per trip, most per unit over Universalis, never above) now also show in the main tab, under "Buy from market board" when it is ticked. They are the same settings as in the Novus tab.
- Animus to Novus takes the Animus out of your hands before talking to Jalzahn. With it equipped, the game refused the enhancement and the step stopped after 45 seconds.
- Gear repair, on by default: between targets of the books, the Atma farm and between autopilot steps, a worn piece at or below 30 % (set in the main tab) gets repaired. Self repair with Dark Matter goes first. Anything still worn after that goes to Alistair, the mender in Limsa Lominsa Lower Decks. If a repair fails, the run goes on and tries again 30 minutes later.
- Books: the 4 second take-off check now starts once vnavmesh has found the route. Long flights, such as across Coerthas, took 4 seconds to plan, so the check cancelled the route and the character rode on the ground instead.
- Messages about missing gear or materia no longer tell Free Trial accounts to buy them. They say the market board is not available and to craft the gear or extract the materia. This covers A Relic Reborn's weapon, the meld step, the HQ Zodiac materials and the Novus materia.
- The autopilot stops before A Relic Reborn when you lack the weapon Gerolt asks for (Barbarian's Bardiche for Bravura, and so on) with its 2 materia melded and cannot buy it. The popup names the weapon and why it was not bought. Before, WigglyQuest talked to Gerolt in a loop.
- On a Free Trial account the "Buy from market board" box shows unticked and cannot be changed. Your saved choice stays for other accounts.
- On a Free Trial account the materia row of the main tab says "by hand (Free Trial)" instead of "autopilot", since nothing is bought on the market board there.
- Report a problem now writes the .log file and copies your text, then gives two buttons: one opens this plugin's thread on our Discord, the other is the server invite for people who are not members yet, since the thread link does not open for them.
- Capture leves also take an armour piece off when one hit removes more than 30 % of a target's HP, before it can die. A level 70 summoner took a winter nix from 100 % to 42 % with one auto-attack.
- Capture leves fight the other spawns that attack you, like the Ragged Hippogryph, with the normal AI and rotation instead of the auto-attack alone, then turn them off again for the targets.
- Report a problem now opens our Discord instead of a GitHub issue. Send the .log file to Kyuuso by DM or post it in the plugin's thread in #plugins. The text you typed is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with the file.
- Capture leves keep your armour on at first. Each target that dies before the /soothe takes one more piece off for that job and level, body and legs first, and the count is saved. A level 100 character may lose a few targets the first time while it learns.
- Free Trial accounts skip every market board purchase and the main tab says so, since the game does not let them use the market board.
- Capture leves no longer switch to normal combat after riding to the next target. Before, the AI came back on and attacked a winter nix that was already pacified.
- Capture leves start the auto-attack with the hotbar's Auto-attack command. The old call got "Cannot execute at this time." with the weak weapon on, so the targets were never hit.
- Capture leves send the chocobo away and turn off the BossMod AI, its preset and Rotation Solver, even when you had them on. Only the auto-attack hits the targets, so a skill or the chocobo no longer kills one before the /soothe.
- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.
Still to test before 1.0: party sharing between two clients, and a second relic on the same character.","TestingDalamudApiLevel":15}

- The autopilot stops before A Relic Reborn when you lack the weapon Gerolt asks for (Barbarian's Bardiche for Bravura, and so on) with its 2 materia melded and cannot buy it. The popup names the weapon and why it was not bought. Before, WigglyQuest talked to Gerolt in a loop.
- On a Free Trial account the "Buy from market board" box shows unticked and cannot be changed. Your saved choice stays for other accounts.
- On a Free Trial account the materia row of the main tab says "by hand (Free Trial)" instead of "autopilot", since nothing is bought on the market board there.
- Report a problem now writes the .log file and copies your text, then gives two buttons: one opens this plugin's thread on our Discord, the other is the server invite for people who are not members yet, since the thread link does not open for them.
- Capture leves also take an armour piece off when one hit removes more than 30 % of a target's HP, before it can die. A level 70 summoner took a winter nix from 100 % to 42 % with one auto-attack.
- Capture leves fight the other spawns that attack you, like the Ragged Hippogryph, with the normal AI and rotation instead of the auto-attack alone, then turn them off again for the targets.
- Report a problem now opens our Discord instead of a GitHub issue. Send the .log file to Kyuuso by DM or post it in the plugin's thread in #plugins. The text you typed is copied to the clipboard so you can paste it with the file.
- Capture leves keep your armour on at first. Each target that dies before the /soothe takes one more piece off for that job and level, body and legs first, and the count is saved. A level 100 character may lose a few targets the first time while it learns.
- Free Trial accounts skip every market board purchase and the main tab says so, since the game does not let them use the market board.
- Capture leves no longer switch to normal combat after riding to the next target. Before, the AI came back on and attacked a winter nix that was already pacified.
- Capture leves start the auto-attack with the hotbar's Auto-attack command. The old call got "Cannot execute at this time." with the weak weapon on, so the targets were never hit.
- Capture leves send the chocobo away and turn off the BossMod AI, its preset and Rotation Solver, even when you had them on. Only the auto-attack hits the targets, so a skill or the chocobo no longer kills one before the /soothe.
- Capture leves in the books no longer swap between the weak weapon and the Atma weapon every second. The Atma weapon goes back on after the targets are soothed, before the turn-in.
- The books summon the chocobo companion with Gysahl Greens for their enemies and FATEs, as the Atma farm already did. Leves stay without it, so it cannot kill a capture target.
- Escort leves (Someone's in the Doghouse): when the escort falls more than 20 yalms behind, the character walks back to it. It used to stay up to 30 yalms ahead, stuck on a rock, sending /beckon that the game answered with "Too far away".
- Dungeon unlocks that need another dungeon cleared first (Halatali before Halatali (Hard)) wait until you are out of it. The clear used to count when the last boss died, so the talk to Hugubert started inside Halatali, three teleports failed, and the book stopped on Mumuepo the Beholden.
- Trips to an NPC wait up to 3 minutes for a duty or cutscene to end before teleporting.
- Lure leves (Don't Forget to Cry): a prime location that lures nothing within 8 seconds is skipped. It used the lure on the same wrong spot every 5 seconds.
- New "Dungeon coffers" option in the Debug tab for book, Braves and unlock dungeons: boss coffers only (default), every coffer, no coffers, or your own DAD/AutoDuty loot settings.
- FATE combat after a dungeon: AutoDuty/DAD turn the BossMod AI off and clear its autorotation preset. /vbmai on is now sent again after each zone change, and without Rotation Solver your last preset (or VBM Default) is set for the fight and cleared after it.
- Atma FATEs inside the U'Ghamaro Mines are done on the ground; the mount stays off past the entrance.
- Jalzahn's furnace is used from (445.9, -66.3), where it worked by hand. When WigglyQuest hovers at Gerolt or the furnace, it lands and walks in.
- The "Do you really want to trade a high-quality item?" prompt is answered on quests Zodiac Helper started.
- Main tab: materia and the class weapon read "autopilot" when market buying is on.
Still to test before 1.0: party sharing between two clients, and a second relic on the same character.","TestingDalamudApiLevel":15}

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"PvP Solver","Punchline":"PvP-only auto-rotation","Description":"PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.","InternalName":"PvPSolver","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.18","TestingAssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.19","Changelog":"v0.1.2.19 (2026-11-17) [testing]
- Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn 866988a7ee, status and target check improvements): the status reads behind target selection use the game's status array directly. Hostile-target filtering, invincible and priority status checks, dispel and dangerous-status detection, and the status-lock check read it without building status objects first (StatusHelper.GetStatuses, TargetUpdater, ObjectHelper, ActionUpdater).
- The check for a full status list reads the status slots directly, and the applied-status lookups read the effect-time cache without touching the status list. The effect-time window is measured on a monotonic tick clock, so a system clock change can no longer extend or cut it (DataCenter.StartEffectTime, Watcher).
- Top-priority hostile checks are cached for 15 ms per target to cut repeated work in the target scan (ObjectHelper.IsTopPriorityHostile). Time-to-kill and resistance checks take their limit from the caller, and the cone and line target checks reuse precomputed trigonometry (ActionTargetInfo).
- Rotation settings that hold a decimal number parse with the invariant culture first and the current culture second, and reject NaN and infinity. The timed action command parses the time the same way, and the IPC action command passes the trimmed action name with the time rounded to three decimals (RotationConfigFloat, RotationConfigBase, RSCommands_OtherCommand, IPCProvider).
- State commands that name a targeting type also accept a numeric index, and the targeting index wraps correctly in both directions (RSCommands_BasicInfo, RSCommands_StateSpecialCommand).
- Delayed target switching ignores a new request while one is still waiting and looks the candidate up by object id when the delay ends, so a target that despawned in between is skipped (RSCommands_Actions.SetTargetWithDelay). {"Author":"dajoey","Name":"PvP Solver","Punchline":"PvP-only auto-rotation","Description":"PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.","InternalName":"PvPSolver","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.18","TestingAssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.19","Changelog":"v0.1.2.19 (2026-11-17) [testing]
- Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn 866988a7ee, status and target check improvements): the status reads behind target selection use the game's status array directly. Hostile-target filtering, invincible and priority status checks, dispel and dangerous-status detection, and the status-lock check read it without building status objects first (StatusHelper.GetStatuses, TargetUpdater, ObjectHelper, ActionUpdater).
- The check for a full status list reads the status slots directly, and the applied-status lookups read the effect-time cache without touching the status list. The effect-time window is measured on a monotonic tick clock, so a system clock change can no longer extend or cut it (DataCenter.StartEffectTime, Watcher).
- Top-priority hostile checks are cached for 15 ms per target to cut repeated work in the target scan (ObjectHelper.IsTopPriorityHostile). Time-to-kill and resistance checks take their limit from the caller, and the cone and line target checks reuse precomputed trigonometry (ActionTargetInfo).
- Rotation settings that hold a decimal number parse with the invariant culture first and the current culture second, and reject NaN and infinity. The timed action command parses the time the same way, and the IPC action command passes the trimmed action name with the time rounded to three decimals (RotationConfigFloat, RotationConfigBase, RSCommands_OtherCommand, IPCProvider).
- State commands that name a targeting type also accept a numeric index, and the targeting index wraps correctly in both directions (RSCommands_BasicInfo, RSCommands_StateSpecialCommand).
- Delayed target switching ignores a new request while one is still waiting and looks the candidate up by object id when the delay ends, so a target that despawned in between is skipped (RSCommands_Actions.SetTargetWithDelay). Macro targets are remembered by object id instead of by object reference (MacroItem).
- The Disable Auto Rotation call to WrathCombo is limited to one per second (IPCSubscriber).
- HP and MP potion use respects the two potion settings before choosing a potion, and the potion items pass the clipping check through (CustomRotation_Items, HpPotionItem, MpPotionItem, BaseItem).
- When the saved configuration cannot be read, a copy is kept as PvPSolver_LoadFailed.json before settings reset (RotationSolverPlugin). The disabled-hotbar highlight reads hotbar slots by reference (HotbarDisabledColor).

- **The Fight Brain countdown strip no longer keeps past forecasts on screen.** A clock mix-up inside the forecast tick compared the entries' Unix timestamps against the machine's uptime clock, so the rule that drops a forecast three seconds after its moment passed could never fire: old entries piled up, filled the forecast list, and the strip showed a fixed set of entries whose countdowns grew ever more negative for the rest of the session. The tick now prunes on the same clock the entries carry, and the strip itself shows only entries still ahead (with one second of grace), so a fight's leftovers disappear instead of counting up in the negative.

v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. {"Author":"GitHixy","Name":"LootView","Punchline":"See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.","Description":"LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

Works with every game language: English, Japanese, German and French.

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Currency drawer beside the overlay with every currency you hold, its cap and the weekly tomestone limit.
- A banner on screen when another player commends you.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner. Roll Need, Greed or Pass right from the panel, with the game's own loot window kept out of the way.
- Collectibles you already have (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles, portrait frames) are marked on their icon.
- Detailed item tooltips with item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots and market price.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any item to try it on, look it up, copy its name or blacklist it.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVACY

{"Author":"GitHixy","Name":"HitSpark","Punchline":"Replace the game's combat numbers with animated, styleable fly text.","Description":"HitSpark replaces Final Fantasy XIV's combat text with its own renderer: better fonts, tuned motion and real impact on critical hits.

WHAT YOU GET

- Every kind of combat text redrawn: damage dealt and taken, healing, misses and evades, status effects, experience, crafting and loot.
- Eight built-in presets, each a complete look: Classic+, Heroic, Tally, Onslaught, Elemental, Grim, Minimal and Retro.
- Real motion: arcs, fountains, rising and falling paths, scrolling columns, and punch, shake, flash, sparks and trails on crits.
- Multi-hits and damage over time that roll up into one number, with DoT ticks in their own colour.
- Other players' numbers shown smaller, or hidden, for your party and for everyone else, with a distance limit.
- Rear and flank hints for positionals, and an option to let numbers pass under the game's UI.
- A style editor for every category with a live preview, and presets you can share as a short code.

GETTING STARTED

Type /hitspark (or /hs) to open the settings and pick a preset. /hitspark test plays sample numbers on you and your target, even out of combat.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you.

PLAYS BY THE RULES

HitSpark is purely cosmetic: it redraws text the game already shows you and follows the game's own flying text and pop-up text options. The only extra is the optional positional hint, worked out from where you're standing. If a game update breaks it, the game's own numbers come back on their own. Settings and presets are stored locally and nothing is ever sent anywhere.","Changelog":"- New "Colour vision" option (Settings → General): adjusts the colours of every preset, your own included, for protan, deutan or tritan colour blindness, so heals, crits and damage taken stay easy to tell apart. - New "Game Default" preset: the game's fonts and plain colours with no extra effects, as close to the native fly text as HitSpark gets. A good base for a style of your own.
- Each category now has its own opacity, fading the text together with its outline, shadow, caption and icon.
- Letter case option: text as the game writes it, UPPER CASE, lower case or Capitalised Words.
- The action name or label can now sit below, above, left or right of the number.
- Fixed buff and debuff icons being stretched sideways.

fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection
47500d7: fix(FaloopIntegration): log the whole spawn_location payload

Passing the nullable ZonePoiId alone as the params argument of the log
call made it a null array when the value was null (CS8604). Log the
whole payload instead, as the spawn case does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

When "Ignore Pending Report" is enabled, a spawn reported without

The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

0f2ec49: Merge pull request #807 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-pending-spawn-location

fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later
6daa4d0: fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later

When "Ignore Pending Report" is enabled, a spawn reported without
coordinates was dropped before being stored, so the following
spawn_location could not find it and was ignored as well.

- Hold location-less spawns as pending and announce them once
  spawn_location arrives
- Accept a null zonePoiId in spawn_location and a singular zonePoiId in spawn
- Replace the stored report on location change instead of appending

8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

{"Author":"dexcss","Name":"Glamour Sorter","AcceptsFeedback":true,"ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.3.0.19","CategoryTags":["Utility","Inventory"],"Changelog":"v1.3.0.19: Spare copies are no longer planned as stores — a piece whose appearance is already in the dresser is dropped from the set plan and reported as a duplicate (the bag copy can be sold), which also removes the HQ leftovers that made the game refuse outfit stores. Skipped sets are always reported now (1.3.0.18 dropped them from the result list), and the plan card note text is fixed. v1.3.0.18: Outfit stores now hand in NQ pieces only — every HQ hand-in made the game refuse the combination silently (all successful stores in the 21:15-21:30 run used NQ pieces, all refusals involved HQ). HQ-only sets are reported as \"the dresser will not take HQ gear as an outfit glamour\" instead of failing after a click. Slot diagnostics also show each planned piece's quality. v1.3.0.17: Failed outfit stores now report the game's own reason — chat messages printed during the attempt are logged under \"game said:\" and the result reads \"The game did not accept this outfit (left for manual review)\", so the remaining refusals can be identified exactly instead of guessed. v1.3.0.16: Confirmation now clicks the real Yes button first (what a player does), then falls back to callback event 2 and event 0 in stages — the seasonal dialog was closing without depositing when only callbacks were fired. Combined with 1.3.0.15, \"already in the stored outfit\" is reported as ALREADY and is no longer counted as a store. v1.3.0.15: Honest results — \"Already in the stored outfit — nothing to add\" is now its own ALREADY state and no longer counts as a successful store; the tally reads stored / already there / need attention / failed. The store step also logs the click and, if no confirmation opens within 2 s, fires the addon's Store as Glamour callback (18) before giving up. v1.3.0.14: Diagnosis + fallback for the seasonal Outfit Glamour Creation stalls — the store step now logs the addon state, hand-in counts and every slot (item id, inventory type, flag), and if no confirmation opens within 2 s it fires the addon's Store as Glamour callback (18) as a fallback. v1.3.0.13: Quality consistency for outfit hand-ins — the outfit window only accepts pieces of one quality (\"Only items of the same quality may be selected\") and a mixed HQ/NQ selection made the game silently refuse the store while leaving the window open. The plugin now anchors on the quality it holds most of and hands in only pieces of that quality, logging any piece skipped for quality. v1.3.0.12: Checkbox-dialog fix — the confirm ladder now ticks the \"Store as Outfit Glamour\" checkbox first (synthetic ButtonClick + SetChecked) and fires Yes once the game enables it, instead of firing the default-confirm callback first, which closed the dialog without depositing on several sets (the \"checkbox was never selected\" symptom). The default-confirm callback is kept as a fallback for dialogs whose Yes cannot be enabled from the checkbox. v1.3.0.11: Cross-set outfit mismatch guard — a glamour piece can belong to more than one outfit set, and the game may open a different set's stored outfit when completing; the plugin now compares the opened outfit's item id with the planned set and skips with \"left for manual review\" instead of handing the piece into the wrong outfit and reporting a false failure. The store log keeps the dialog mode and prism-box index so any remaining case is diagnosable. v1.3.0.10: Fix the \"No deposit detected\" failures on outfit completions. The hand-in loop was allowed to target a slot already marked Filled (the outfit already contained that piece), which the game silently refused; it now only hands into Unfilled slots, and a set whose planned pieces are all already inside the outfit reports \"Already in the stored outfit — nothing to add\" instead of attempting a store. The native StoreExistingOutfit retry from 1.3.0.9 is removed — it returns success but deposits nothing unless the Glamour Creation window drives it. v1.3.0.9: Fix false \"No deposit detected\" results when completing an outfit — the game's confirm dialog sometimes closes without depositing for outfits that were only just created. After 1.5 s without a change the plugin now sends the same request the dialog sends (StoreExistingOutfit/StoreNewOutfit) once, then re-checks; store logs also report the dialog mode and prism-box index for diagnosis. v1.3.0.8: Withdraw tab clarity — the action buttons now state what they will do and grey out with an explicit empty-state label: \"No duplicates to withdraw\", \"No singles to withdraw\", and \"No sets to withdraw & re-deposit\" when there is nothing to pack (otherwise \"Withdraw & re-deposit sets (N)\" with counts). The consolidation description now explains the withdraw-then-pack-as-outfit loop and the slot saving. v1.3.0.7: Fix a window render crash when the set-consolidation loop ran with no loose set pieces left to start (the empty candidate list was indexed directly) — it now reports \"Nothing to consolidate\" instead. The consolidation pump is also exception-guarded so a future error cannot take the whole window down. v1.3.0.6: Set consolidation now runs in bag-sized batches — it withdraws one set's loose pieces (only as many as your free bag slots can hold), stores that set as a single outfit glamour, then repeats automatically. Before this the button tried to withdraw every loose set piece at once (359 items against 63 free slots) and was refused. v1.3.0.5: Dresser-full handling — at 800/800 the store run now stops with a clear 'Glamour Dresser is full' result instead of failing every remaining item with 'no deposit detected'. New \"set pieces stored loose\" detector on the Withdraw tab: it finds items the dresser stores individually that belong to an outfit set, shows how many pieces/sets and the approximate slots that would be freed, withdraws them (arm-then-confirm), then automatically runs the store pass that packs each set into one outfit glamour. v1.3.0.4: Single-item deposits now work — loose glamour items (not part of an outfit set) are stored with the game's own prism-box request command (the same request the Glamour Creation window's Yes button sends) instead of trying to open the outfit-store window, which the game only opens for set items. Each item costs one glamour prism (checked first) and the result reports \"Stored item (dresser X->Y)\". Outfit sets keep the existing flow. v1.3.0.3: Withdraw fix — the extractor was waiting on the dresser's 'requested' flag, which stays set while the data is loaded, so a run could stop before sending anything (\"the dresser data stayed busy\"); it now only gates on the loaded flag and retries refused sends. Store: the hand-in window is allowed to finish populating before the fill step decides nothing can be handed over. UI: two pages — Deposit (scan/store) and Withdraw (extractor) — with Abort reachable on the active page. v1.3.0.2: Gear-set protection hardening — items saved in a gear set are now detected from the saved gearset entries as well as the game's gear-set icon check (a 1.3.0.0 test scan saw 110 protected pieces on one pass and only 1 on another, so a piece could be misfiled as sortable). Deposit verification now reads the dresser list from MirageManager, so a dresser window that is momentarily unreadable no longer turns a successful deposit into a false \"couldn't read the dresser\" warning. v1.3.0.1: Fixes from the first 1.3.0.0 test. The dresser's \"Add to pre-existing outfit glamour?\" Yes/No prompt (shown when completing a stored outfit) is now answered automatically — before this it left the store flow stuck with the prompt on screen and froze the run. The Abort button stays clickable while a run is in progress. New watchdogs stop a set whose store window never opens or never produces its confirmation instead of stalling the rest of the run. Extractor: a refused RestorePrismBoxItem is retried (the client briefly refuses while a previous restore settles), waits for the dresser data request to finish, and skips further copies of a unique item (the game cannot give you a second copy while you hold one) instead of stopping the whole run; log lines now name the refused item. v1.3.0.0: Loose items — glamour-able items that belong to no outfit set are now stored as well, one at a time, and skipped when that item is already anywhere in the dresser. Extractor — withdraw dresser items back into your bags: all loose items, duplicates only (keeps one of each), or one item or item type such as all rings, with a live progress line. Item names and icons — planned pieces, duplicates and results now show the item icon, name and category instead of a raw item id. v1.2.0.1: Audit fixes. Completing an existing outfit works again — the pieces a stored outfit is still missing are planned as needed and are no longer listed as sellable duplicates. Deposit verification also accepts the planned pieces leaving your bags, so completing an outfit (or storing with a nearly full dresser) reports correctly instead of \"No deposit detected\". Store steps can no longer drop a set silently when a window does not open or the dresser closes mid-run, the store loop retries briefly while the dresser data reloads instead of stopping the rest of the run, and the Armoire toggle is locked while storing. /xllog now logs the scanned dresser/held counts for troubleshooting. v1.2.0.0: Full audit. Gear-set protection — pieces registered to a saved gear set are now left in your bags (the same check the game uses for its gear-set icon mark), instead of being pulled out of your gear sets. Smarter duplicates — stored outfit glamours are expanded into their pieces, so a second copy of an already-stored piece is flagged as sellable instead of being re-stored. The dresser's expanded item list is scanned, and a never-fill guard skips window slots the game already marks as part of the stored outfit. New model-duplicate hints show when a planned piece shares its appearance with something already stored. Deposit verification now retries briefly instead of failing on a single read. UI: version in the title, live progress tally while storing, MANUAL tag priority, gear-set and model-duplicate sections. {"Author":"dajoey","Name":"Gluttony Combo","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.4.340","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v1.0.4.341 (2026-11-17) [testing]
- **The Fight Brain countdown strip no longer keeps past forecasts on screen.** A clock mix-up inside the forecast tick compared the entries' Unix timestamps against the machine's uptime clock, so the rule that drops a forecast three seconds after its moment passed could never fire: old entries piled up, filled the forecast list, and the strip showed a fixed set of entries whose countdowns grew ever more negative for the rest of the session. The tick now prunes on the same clock the entries carry, and the strip itself shows only entries still ahead (with one second of grace), so a fight's leftovers disappear instead of counting up in the negative.
- **The Fight Brain countdown strip only draws during combat now.** Outside a fight it draws nothing, even while the forecast source is still answering, so the strip no longer sits on the screen between fights.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.340 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt in the same custom window style as the other plugins and polished for the real in-game font and scale, with every preset, option and saved setting unchanged.
- The window uses a two-level layout: Combos, Automation and System tabs, a row of destinations for the open tab, a page header and a status footer that stays in view. Long pages fade out above the footer instead of being cut off.
- Preset cards have even padding, a larger title and toggles that sit inside the card, and a whole toggle row, label included, can be clicked. Search keeps one width on every page, shows a dimmed hint, has a clear button and reports a result count.
- The problem report button sits in the footer so it is reachable on every page and window size, and the status pill shows a running rotation in green and a blocked one in amber.
- This build also picks up the restyled shared What's new window and Report a problem popup.

v1.0.4.339 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v1.0.4.338 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v1.0.4.337 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **The AI decision layer is gone.** The Fight Brain's question side - the raidwide mitigation ask, the pre-pull plan reader (party finder text and the `/gluttony plan` note command), and the party-callout reader - has been removed from the plugin, together with its relay address setting and the two "Plan Reader"/"Callout Reader" switches. GluttonyCombo no longer asks any decision model anything, sends no snapshot anywhere, and keeps no relay URL: the only network path it still uses is the movement tap's `/move/ingest` upload, which records the movement profiles and never carried a decision.
- What stays is pure code and unchanged: the rotation and every combo, the Fight Brain forecast reads and `FB|forecast` lines, the countdown strip, the shadow cast-gate lines, the party-data shadow rules (`FB|party-mit`, `FB|pos-zone`), and the movement recorder and shadow move planner. The move planner's `MP|` decision lines keep their exact format and now always carry the code pick only.
- The shadow move planner no longer has its ask-side toggle; `/gluttony movelog` now switches the recorder and the planner together, and its status line reads two switches instead of three.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.336 (2026-11-09) [testing]
- **Saving a custom action to a hotbar while in PvP now writes the PvP layout.** The custom-action editor's hotbar save told the game the write was a normal-slot write regardless of the current content, so a save made while in PvP updated the regular hotbar set instead of the PvP one; the call now passes the content check (upstream's fix), so the PvP variant of the slot is the one written.
- **The action-replacing hook answers in the game's own yes/no shape.** The IsActionIdReplaceable detour and its delegate declared an unsigned 64-bit return where the game's callback uses a boolean, so the replace decision relied on 0/1 marshalling to land correctly; both signatures now match the native BOOL return (upstream's fix), and the early-return values read true/false instead of 1/0. No behavior change is intended - this removes a latent hook-contract mismatch.
