{"Author":"Valenth Siveria","Name":"I Am Ready","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.1.0.0","Changelog":"API15 finally","DalamudApiLevel":"15","Description":"# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"LazyCrafter","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.7.13","CategoryTags":["utility"],"Changelog":"v0.1.7.13 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The catalog table keeps its sortable, resizable and reorderable columns and its right-click menu for showing and hiding columns; columns that do not fit start hidden.
- Numeric column headers line up with the figures beneath them in the catalog, cart, ledger and run tables, and no header is cut mid-word at larger UI scales.
- Recipe details are organised into summary, ingredient and market cards, with source and unit price under each ingredient and the fulfil buttons beside them.
- The Settings and Run pages no longer repeat the same warning or state word, and short windows get a compact page header that leaves more room for the table.

v0.1.7.12 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The plugin window now uses a responsive card-based shell for catalog, cart, run and settings, with integrated area navigation, destination search, live page counts, a close button in the header and persistent dispatch and footer actions. Catalog logic, cart editing, dispatch, integrations and saved configuration are unchanged.

v0.1.7.11 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.7.10 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v0.1.7.9 (2026-10-17) [testing]
- **Market-price lookups no longer log warnings while they retry.** When Universalis is slow or busy it answers with a temporary "try again" status or takes longer than before; the price client already retries those on its own with a pause between tries - that is its designed behavior, not a fault, so those lines now go to the debug log. Only one warning is written when a batch gives up entirely after all retries, and stale cached prices are used meanwhile, exactly as before.
- **The price client now waits up to 60 seconds per request instead of 20.** Under load, Universalis sometimes finishes a large price query just after the old 20-second cutoff; the request was cancelled while the server was still working on it and the prices for that batch were refetched from scratch. - The buttons drawn on the retainer list and the retainer sale list (Auto Pinch, Auto Market, Sweep to Bags, and Running with Stop while a run goes) no longer cover the window's close button or the venture count beside it (issue #12). - Untried build: tested offline, not yet in the game.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.2.8.25 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The Auto-Market panel docked beside the inventory window now lists only the marketable bag stacks, each with its existing per-row controls (list switch, Add/Remove, Stack, Keep, Skip category routing), under a title line with a close button. - The main window's Auto-Market page has a new "Inventory panel" card with "Dock to inventory", "Stay open when the inventory closes", the Status and Category filters that narrow the panel's list, the On list / Not listed / Excluded counts, and the "Add all marketable stacks in bags" and "Remove all" actions, each still confirming first (Windows/ConfigWindow.cs, DrawInventoryPanelCard). - While a status or category filter is set, the bulk actions read "Add all shown" and "Remove all shown" and only touch the stacks the panel lists (AutoMarket/AutoMarketPanelModel.cs, PanelRows and PlanSettingsBulk).
- The panel's search box, its "Show unmarketable" switch (unmarketable stacks are no longer listed), its docked or floating status line, its Stop button and its "Turn Auto-Market on?" confirmation. Every Auto-Market setting the panel repeated is on the main window's Auto-Market page, whose footer Stop and the /lmc cancel command still stop a running action. "Enable Auto-Market" switches on from the main window without a confirmation, as it already did there.
- Untried build: tested offline, not yet in the game.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.2.8.24 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The window has a new look with a header showing the plugin name, a status pill and a close button, sub-pages as pill tabs, and a status footer that shows the current state and a Stop button while an action runs.
- Settings are grouped into cards, and the Auto-Market panel and the entries list show each item as its own card with its full name, switch, stack and keep fields. Long item names are shortened in the middle so the "(HQ)" marker always stays visible, and hovering shows the full name.
- Narrow windows stack the controls and wrap captions and notices instead of cutting them, and long tables keep their column headers visible while scrolling.
- The shared What's new window and Report a problem popup were restyled and now use the same custom window style as the plugin windows.

v0.2.8.23 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The main window, the docked Auto-Market panel, the inventory page, the ownership tooltip, the confirmation prompts and the retainer overlay buttons now use responsive card-based layouts with pink navigation, track-style toggles and rounded controls, and running, idle, empty and ready states are worded the same way everywhere. All settings and behaviour are unchanged.
- The main window and the Auto-Market panel each have a custom close (X) button, wide tables scroll only inside their own area, and the Auto-Market panel gained a persistent state footer with a Stop button for a running action.
- The Report a problem button moved from the tab bar to a Support section on the Retainers & Hotkeys page; it writes the same local report as before.
- Untried build: tested offline against the plugin's offline test suite, not yet in the game.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.2.8.22 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- **Mannequin detection no longer skips every real listing on German, French and Japanese clients.** The check compared the context menu against the price window title text (Addon sheet row 930) instead of the menu's own Adjust Price action text (row 959). On English clients the two read the same, but on German, French and Japanese clients they differ, so each real listing looked like a mannequin and was skipped. The check now reads the menu action text (the fix is ported from upstream Dagobert's Auto Pinch).
- Untried build: tested offline against the plugin's offline test suite, not yet in the game.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

{"Author":"Akari","Name":"Mahjong Advisor","AcceptsFeedback":true,"ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.4.4.0","CanUnloadAsync":false,"CategoryTags":["Utility"],"Changelog":"v0.4.4.0: Chi picker freeze fix. When a call prompt's claimed tile could not be identified, the single-shape chi gate counted shapes for the wrong tile: each candidate offered one run, but the actual tile completed two, so the game opened its shape-selection dialog - which ignores call callbacks - and the match froze (live at South 4 while leading 38,400; bundle 20261030-081345). Chi now fires only when the claim is pinned to one tile, or when every tile that could legally be on offer completes exactly one run; anything else passes instead. The picker-stall warning also logs once rather than every frame. The stale Advisor block that earlier builds wrote into the plugin config is no longer serialised: it was never read, is ignored on load, and disappears at the next config save. An experimental rollout-search re-ranking of discard candidates is included but ships OFF: a 240-match paired simulator A/B (two seeds) rejected it - it traded a 39% relative win-rate drop for nothing - so it stays a foundation for later work. v0.4.3.0: Result-screen retry. The result panel can swallow the first advance callback while it animates; the controller fired it twice and then its acted guard blocked every retry, leaving the screen waiting indefinitely (live Advanced freeze, state 29 unresolved for 12s). Advances now retry every 2.5 seconds while the result state persists, capped at 8 attempts so the deliberately manual match-end screen is not spammed. v0.4.2.0: Match-level tuning. A full hanchan evaluator now plays East+South with real score accounting, dealer rotation, honcha, riichi sticks and placement, and 120 paired matches showed the old risk settings were too passive. Win value 1800 and deal-in cost 4000 beat 1300/5200 on identical deals (average place 2.55 vs 2.65, more firsts, fewer fourths) with the deal-in rate unchanged at 9.3%. A v7 config migration applies the new values. Riichi hand value and placement stance were also tested and left unchanged - both were flat across 60-match arms. v0.4.1.0: Advanced-table defence. Cross-seat genbutsu now uses the pond lengths captured at the instant a riichi marker appears; the old turn-count shortcut broke once calls shortened ponds and could mark a tile discarded before the riichi as safe. Two declared riichi also force a fold for any hand that is not tenpai, overriding the placement chase. The simulator now records the same declaration snapshots: over 1,000 hands the defence fix moved deal-in rate from 10.3% to 9.5% and average points from -22 to +17, while the double-riichi rail was neutral there because the simulation has no placement stance. Live Advanced trial on 0.4.0.0 finished 1st, 4th, then leading when stopped; the 4th lost two deal-ins to one riichi player, the second 12,000 while two were in riichi. v0.4.0.0: Exact scoring core. Completed hands are now scored by yaku, fu, dora and the payment table (closed and open, riichi through yakuman), and the offline simulator uses that scoring for win legality and payouts. Ready-hand valuation was built and benchmarked but stays out of live decisions: over 1,500 simulated hands, mixing exact tenpai values with the existing one-away estimate cut the win rate from 15.4% to 8.1%, so the value scale must be unified for every shanten first. Advice is memoised per table state so the overlay and controller do not recompute the same decision. v0.3.10.0: Silent-endgame defence. The threat model measured a silent opponent as at most 19% likely tenpai, so on a table with no riichi and no melds every safety rule stayed off - the controller pushed one-away hands with 6-9 tiles left to draw into damaten twice in one match (4,200 and 2,200 deal-ins) and paid full tsumo on 14,300 and 20,000 hands. Silent seats now take on a readiness floor that rises from zero at wall 32 to a concrete threat at wall 16, arming the existing late-wall fold and per-tile safety ranking on quiet tables. v0.3.9.0: Chi freeze fixed. The shape-selection dialog ignores scripted call picks (confirmed by the first picker dump), so chi now only fires when exactly one shape is possible - that path completes with no dialog. Multi-shape chi passes instead of stalling; the pass log records how many shapes were declined. v0.3.8.0: Late-wall defence. When an opponent is a concrete threat and the wall is down to the last four go-arounds, the controller folds any hand that is not tenpai instead of pushing a 1-shanten no-riichi hand. This was the 12,000 deal-in in the first match. Diagnostic bundles now also include chi picker dumps. The end-of-match results screen still waits for you by design - that is the one click after a match. v0.3.7.0: Chi is now fully automated. The controller calls chi when the advisor ranks it best, and if the client shows the shape-selection surface it fires the first variant and re-evaluates the hand. The picker layout is dumped once per session to the log folder so shape-specific selection can be refined against real captures. A v6 config migration enables chi. v0.3.6.0: Read each opponent meld strip independently. A hidden empty strip for one quiet seat no longer suppresses every visible meld on the table, so the threat model sees called sets when they exist. This is a readiness/defence accuracy change; automation logic is unchanged. v0.3.5.0: Fix the second freeze. A complete open hand is no longer assumed to be a legal tsumo: the controller checks for an actual yaku and keeps discarding when there is none. Call prompts now prefer the newest board addition over a possibly stale pond tile (the live log claimed 6z/dragon while the actual Pon was 9m), and the log records the last discard tile/seat. A v5 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging. v0.3.4.0: Fix the self-kan freeze. A Kan/Pass bar at state 6 is ignored and the normal discard proceeds instead of firing a Pass callback the client ignores. {"Author":"Akari","Name":"Market Helper","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"1.17.29.0","CategoryTags":["Utility"],"DalamudApiLevel":15,"Description":"Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with five tabs:

UNDERCUT — Walk a summoning bell's retainers and undercut every listed item. HQ and NQ are handled separately, your own retainers are matched rather than undercut, per-item overrides and price memory are supported, an obvious troll price is skipped, and mannequin/display items are never touched (if a row can't be verified it is skipped rather than risk delisting it). Closes the bell when it finishes.

LISTER — Build a list (hold CTRL and hover an item, or search) and press Go to list them all. Prices each item at the most common market price, ignoring lone troll listings, against your world, data center or whole region. Per-item stack sizes and list amounts, rolls extra items to the next retainer at the 20-slot cap, and includes a no-touch dry run.

FLIPPER — Compare any marketable item across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modelling.

ITEM GATHERER — Pull designated items off your retainers into your bags, optionally returning your market listings first. Manual withdraw/deposit actions included.

BUYER — Build a shopping list by hand or import a MakePlace furniture list, then SCAN the market per world via Universalis and press SEND to travel with Lifestream and buy across worlds. Every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it is accepted. Listings are bought whole, so by default it never buys a bigger stack than you still need, and a hard sanity ceiling caps the price even with no cap set. If a planned listing has already been bought it chases the next cheapest, on other worlds if needed, until your order is filled. Dry run is on by default.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

{"Author":"dajoey","Name":"PvP Solver","ApplicableVersion":"any","AssemblyVersion":"0.1.2.18","CategoryTags":null,"Changelog":"v0.1.2.19 (2026-11-17) [testing]
- Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn 866988a7ee, status and target check improvements): the status reads behind target selection use the game's status array directly. Hostile-target filtering, invincible and priority status checks, dispel and dangerous-status detection, and the status-lock check read it without building status objects first (StatusHelper.GetStatuses, TargetUpdater, ObjectHelper, ActionUpdater).
- The check for a full status list reads the status slots directly, and the applied-status lookups read the effect-time cache without touching the status list. The effect-time window is measured on a monotonic tick clock, so a system clock change can no longer extend or cut it (DataCenter.StartEffectTime, Watcher).
- Top-priority hostile checks are cached for 15 ms per target to cut repeated work in the target scan (ObjectHelper.IsTopPriorityHostile). Time-to-kill and resistance checks take their limit from the caller, and the cone and line target checks reuse precomputed trigonometry (ActionTargetInfo).
- Rotation settings that hold a decimal number parse with the invariant culture first and the current culture second, and reject NaN and infinity. The timed action command parses the time the same way, and the IPC action command passes the trimmed action name with the time rounded to three decimals (RotationConfigFloat, RotationConfigBase, RSCommands_OtherCommand, IPCProvider).
- State commands that name a targeting type also accept a numeric index, and the targeting index wraps correctly in both directions (RSCommands_BasicInfo, RSCommands_StateSpecialCommand).
- Delayed target switching ignores a new request while one is still waiting and looks the candidate up by object id when the delay ends, so a target that despawned in between is skipped (RSCommands_Actions.SetTargetWithDelay). Macro targets are remembered by object id instead of by object reference (MacroItem).
- The Disable Auto Rotation call to WrathCombo is limited to one per second (IPCSubscriber).
- HP and MP potion use respects the two potion settings before choosing a potion, and the potion items pass the clipping check through (CustomRotation_Items, HpPotionItem, MpPotionItem, BaseItem).
- When the saved configuration cannot be read, a copy is kept as PvPSolver_LoadFailed.json before settings reset (RotationSolverPlugin). The disabled-hotbar highlight reads hotbar slots by reference (HotbarDisabledColor).
- Not carried: upstream changes to rotations and windows this plugin does not contain (extra and Reborn PvE rotations, the main window, the auto-attack updater, the changelog json), and upstream's wider rewrite of the status reader methods, which this plugin's own status code does not share a base with. Defensive null checks on the status list stay in place.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.1.2.18 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The first-start tutorial has a new look and walks through the PvP Solver settings window tab by tab, with buttons that open the matching tab.
- The control and cooldown windows have a clean bordered look, and an unlocked window can be moved by a small handle along its top edge.
- The full legacy settings window has a matching header that shows the plugin version, with a Reset button and a close button. The reset and restore confirmations in the Advanced tab no longer show a plain title bar.
- The What's new window and the Report a problem popup now use the same custom window style as the plugin windows.

v0.1.2.17 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The window uses a header band with a brand chip, a drawn close button, a fixed-width status pill, a section band and a footer with the main action.
- Settings are rows inside cards, with the label and a muted help line on the left, the control on the right and a Reset beside any value that differs from its default.
- Slider values are printed beside the track and still open for typing with Ctrl+click; the target priority list has Up, Down and Remove buttons and an In use now tag, and the job picker shows one row per role.
- Buttons and link chips wrap instead of clipping, dropdowns are as wide as their longest option, and the reset and restore confirmations are centred over the window with a dimmed backdrop.

v0.1.2.16 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The settings window has been rebuilt as a responsive card-based shell with custom two-level navigation, toggle tracks, styled sliders and choices, a custom close button in place of the native title bar, and a persistent Stop footer. Rotation, targeting, presets and saved settings are unchanged.

v0.1.2.15 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.2.14 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.


- **Removed the AI decision layer.** The optional relayed decision model (focus picking, Limit Break firing and the healer-call shadow lines, with their "call the shots" settings row and its relay address field) is gone from the plugin. No fight snapshot is built or sent anywhere anymore, and the plugin makes no decision calls of any kind.
- Targeting, Guard, Recuperate, the defensive table, StickyTarget and every other rotation behavior are unchanged. The defensive rules keep reading real HP (current HP out of the maximum) under the neutral name `RealHp.HpRatio`; no threshold or default moved.
- PvP Solver still never moves the character and never fires a PvP Limit Break on its own logic, exactly as before.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.


- **The Jev co-pilot logs the plain code rule's answer beside Jev's, for both of its questions.** Each `JV|focus-pick` line names the enemy Jev picked and the enemy the plain rule would pick (the lowest-HP enemy in attack range); each `JV|lb-shadow` line names Jev's Limit Break call and the code rule's. Both answers are recorded side by side and graded after the session, to show which one decides better. Log only: targeting, Limit Break firing and every other behavior are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.


- Upstream engine sync (RotationSolverReborn a560469db): the rotation engine now builds in upstream's merged single-project layout.
- Ports upstream engine fixes: the action manager is read at call time instead of a pointer cached at startup (a stale-pointer crash class), configuration saves are atomic (write to a temp file, then replace), and the shield-value calculation can no longer overflow on very large HP values.

- Routine sub-checks. A routine can have its own boxes: one for each roulette, a Tank You pick, 12 allied society boxes and Grand Company chips. "Edit routines" changes the rows.
- Relics by job. The Relics area has a By job view and line cards with progress bars. To fill the Armor and GARO frames, update Tales of Milestones to this version and import a new export.
- Societies, currents and collections. Societies show unlock lines and rank bars. Aether currents are listed by zone. Collections are grouped by availability, with Online Store links.
- Settings area. Character, display, and backup and import settings are in one area. The Ledger holds up to 8 characters, and times can show in UTC or local time.
- Themes. The three themes are Lunar night, Crystarium and Light. Expansion tags use the colours of the Lodestone patch notes.
- Jobs meter. The rail has a Jobs meter that adds your combat, crafting and gathering levels, out of 3,330.
- Fix: after an import, the relic row in the list of changes counts relic items. Before, a stage upgrade showed no change, for example "9 to 9".","SourceRepo":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LegendsOfTheGame/TimeMemoriaV3/main/repo.json"}

    1.5.0.91: 
    * Removed Burst Strike/Fated Circle to Bloodfest as you now cannot overcap with Bloodfest.
    * Added Bloodfest to No Mercy.
    * Fixed a bug where Blizzard/Fire switcher did not work without Enochian unlocked.

    1.5.0.90: 
    * Updated to 7.4.
    * Some more changes coming soon but emergency maintenance started RIP
    
    1.5.0.82:
    * Reawakened Fangs Feature now also applies to Steel Maw.
    
    1.5.0.79:
    * Phlegma into Eukrasian Dyskrasia added.
    
    1.5.0.73:
    * Meisui/Tenri priority fixed and DWaD to Meisui added.
    * Monk's Draconic Leap feature now properly syncs below level 50 when you don't have a form.
    * Raise Hard Target Lockout Feature added.
    
    1.5.0.72:
    * Double Down features now account for its new cost.
    * New option for Royal Authority to Atonement where it will only activate if you are about to overwrite Sword Oath in your combo.
    * Empyreal Arrow will no longer turn into Pitch Perfect under any circumstances.
    
    1.5.0.71:
    * Updated for 7.1 compatibility.
    * Devilment to Starfall Dance feature removed as it is now vanilla.
    * Removed Jump to Mirage Dive due to it being vanilla, as I completely forgot to earlier.
    * Added an 'Only When Full' option to Sidewinder to Pitch Perfect.

    1.5.0.70:
    * Added Comet Overwrite Prevention feature. Or did I?
    * Removed Holy overcap features (it made no sense when you gain, not lose, DPS by letting it overcap).
    
    1.5.0.69 (Nice):
    * Sacrificium Feature added.
    * Despair to Flare Star added.
    * Dragon Kick to Forbidden Chakra added.
    
    1.5.0.67:
    * Blizzard 3 & 2 to Flare Star feature added.
    
    1.5.0.61:
    * Lucid Dreaming Reminders now have a configurable MP threshold, as well as a configurable cooldown remaining offset where they stop replacing the cooldown.
    
    1.5.0.60:
    * Combos to Saber Dance during Devilment feature added.
    * Some other stuff added to Dancer, too. Maybe.
    * Phlegma to Psyche added.
    
    1.5.0.59:
    * Isle Sprint feature added.
    
    1.5.0.53:
    * Reaving Steel added from regular XIVComboExpanded. Maybe something else, too? Tis a secret.
    * Hooking Hooksets and Chummy Cast added.
    
    1.5.0.51:
    * Chaotic Glide added.
    
    1.5.0.49:
    * Standard Step into Technical Step added.
    
    1.5.0.41:
    * Viper features added.
